With magnificent <mark>views of the Bey Mountains</mark> and <mark>20,000 square metres</mark> of orange groves, discover every shade of green, reconnect with nature and wake up to birdsong in comfortable and elegant living spaces.

Each villa features an open-plan kitchen, three bedrooms, three toilets, two bathrooms and three balconies, allowing you to enjoy a spacious and comfortable environment.

manifesto.title: Step outside your villa,
manifesto.subtitle: everything is close.
manifesto.lead: Minta Hills is situated at the heart of one of the Mediterranean's most popular travel regions. Spend your morning on a <mark>2,365-metre summit</mark>, your afternoon in the bay of an ancient city and your evening beside <mark>eternal flames</mark>.
manifesto.description: All of the destinations below can be visited on a day trip. During your stay, feel free to ask us about routes and ways to get there.

featured.title: Mount Tahtalı and
featured.subtitle: Olympos Cable Car.
featured.description: Rising from the Mediterranean coast to an altitude of 2,365 metres, the cable car is one of Kemer's best-known experiences. From the summit, you can see the entire coastline and, on clear days, the inland ranges of the Taurus Mountains. Even in summer, the summit is cool, so we recommend bringing an extra layer of clothing.
featured.imageAlt: Snow-covered Mount Tahtalı viewed from Olympos Beach

grid.title: <italic>A week</italic> in Kemer,
grid.subtitle: a different route every day.
grid.description: From ancient cities and hiking trails to beaches and air sports, most experiences in the surrounding area are less than an hour away from the resort.

lycianWay.title: Türkiye's first long-distance hiking trail
lycianWay.description: Stretching approximately 540 kilometres from Fethiye to Antalya, this marked trail also passes through the Kemer region. You don't have to walk the entire route; explore the Göynük, Çıralı and Olympos sections on day trips.

phaselis.title: Ancient City of Phaselis
phaselis.description: An ancient port city with three natural harbours. The path through the ruins leads directly to the beach, allowing you to combine sightseeing and swimming in one place.
phaselis.imageAlt: Theatre of the ancient city of Phaselis

cirali.title: Çıralı Beach
cirali.description: Approximately three kilometres of peaceful coastline. Development is limited because the beach is a nesting site for loggerhead sea turtles, making it ideal for a day away from the crowds.
cirali.imageAlt: Çıralı Beach and its morning scenery

chimaera.title: Yanartaş (Chimaera)
chimaera.description: A mountainside where natural gas emerging from the ground has been burning for centuries. The flames are particularly impressive after dark, making sunset an ideal time to visit.

paragliding.title: From the summit to the Mediterranean
paragliding.description: The summit of Mount Tahtalı is one of the region's well-known tandem paragliding locations. Take the cable car up and glide towards the coast. Flights depend on weather conditions.

goynuk.title: Göynük Canyon
goynuk.description: A hiking trail in Göynük, near Kemer, where crystal-clear water flows between steep cliffs. One of the coolest routes in the area during the summer heat.

kemerMarina.title: Marina, coastline and boat tours
kemerMarina.description: Everyday essentials, restaurants and the coastline are just four kilometres from the resort. Boats departing from the marina offer daily trips to Phaselis and nearby bays.
